about_the_game:
You are Viri, the last descendant of humans who refused to abandon Earth. Restore the world using hard work, a kind heart, and a Touch of mystical gifts. Feel every change: warm breezes rustle revived grasslands, bugs hum in renewed wetlands, and storms retreat as balance returns.

HEAL THE WORLD

Plant & Cultivate: Grow diverse flora to revive lost biomes—watch butterflies return and weather shift as ecosystems heal.

Recycle & Craft: Turn trash into tools, decor for your home, or offerings for ancient shrines.

Clean & Nurture: Improve dried out soil, create habitats, and witness sound around you evolve with your progress.

Befriend Baltic Folklore Spirits: Help mystical guardians of nature—each with unique quests and stories.

The World That Feels Alive: Soft warm palettes, calming yet vivid—like a folk tale breathed to life.

WE MADE A GAME FOR COZY GAMERS

✅ Stress-free: no timers, no fail states.

✅ Meaningful impact: your care directly revives ecosystems.

✅ Rich atmosphere: adaptive soundtrack + ASMR-like nature sounds.

✅ Intuitive mechanics with folklore storytelling.

Wishlist Now – coming soon!

name: The Regreening

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4790 or AM D Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760, 2 GB or AMD Radeon R9 280X, 3 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: In our cozy nature-restoration management game, you are the last human on Earth, but your task isn’t survival—it’s renewal. Regreen habitats by planting seeds, restore habitats to welcome back folklore animals, and nurture ecosystems to life. Trade resource extraction for purposeful healing.
